title: Austin: New Schools, Motorized Firepower
summary:
*   **School Funding:** A $150,000 bond issue was proposed to taxpayers for new school construction, building repairs, and land purchases.
*   **Fire Department Modernization:** The city accepted and paid for a new motorized "Auto Fire Apparatus" (early fire truck) and appointed its drivers, upgrading emergency services.
*   **City Infrastructure:** Approved repairs for the City Hospital and formally established the precise center line for West 12th Street.
*   **Taxpayer Reimbursement:** Addressed erroneous tax assessments, including a refund for taxes paid in 1891 on land that was not legally within Austin's city limits.

Taxes

The following resolutions (2) were passed by the City Council on the 17th day of Feby
1912, but were not handed to the Clerk until this day, Feby 2st, and after the proceedings
for the 20th of Feby had been recorded,hence they are recorded here.
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, J S Crawford on the
15th day of Feby 1912 made oath that the rendition of his property for the year 1911 was
erroneous, in that five hund -dred ($500.00) dollars in money on hand was assessed against
him ,which money, the said J S Crawford alleges under oath per his affidavit hereto
attached,was not his own, and that he had no money of his own on deposite or elsewhere on
the 1st day of January 1911; therefore , Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of
Austin : (1) That the assessment of the said J S Crawford for the year 1911 have credit by
the amount of five hundred ($500.00) dollars erroneously assessed against him.
(2) That the Assessor and Collector of this City take credit upon the assessment rolls the
charge against him for the year 1911by the amount of said five hundred ($500.00) dollars.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Woolridge, Councilmen Hart
,Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Bartholomew 1

Municipal taxation for that year; and, Whereas, E Burhhard owes municipal taxes fot the
year 1899,which, with inte -rest and penalty amounted on the 15th day of January of the
